name: Frazzlespark's Crate
summary: A delivery from Frazzlespark is bound for Old Krom'rosh at Rog'mar. Carry the crate there quickly and carefully.

sections.title: A Careful Delivery
sections.body: Frazzlespark has a package for Old Krom'rosh, who is waiting at Rog'mar just west of here. You are asked to carry it quickly and carefully, though the reason is left unspoken. Krom'rosh's dealings help accomplish the group's goals.

faq.q: Who is waiting for Frazzlespark's crate?
faq.answer: Old Krom'rosh is waiting for Frazzlespark's crate at Rog'mar.
Rog'mar is just west of Frazzlespark.

faq.q: What should I do with the crate?
faq.answer: Carry Frazzlespark's crate to Old Krom'rosh at Rog'mar, quickly and carefully.

faq.q: Why does the crate need careful delivery?
faq.answer: Frazzlespark advises you to deliver it quickly and carefully but gives no reason.

faq.q: Why does Krom'rosh make these kinds of dealings?
faq.answer: Krom'rosh says such dealings help accomplish their goals.
